items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Of course he had that Snubs Mosley and the sliding saxophone

ctx.x: Lee band, Jap Allen, and so you see, whenever they played a dance--I never was participating in a jam session, but some of my men was always there, and I would be there looking to see what was happening, and you could get to see what was going on and make your choice and just see what was going on.

(Inaudible) Trent I think had one of the greatest bands that ever happened anywhere and he came into Tulsa, and that was one of my favorites. Of course he had that Snubs Mosley and the sliding saxophone, Lee Hilliard--

Let me interrupt you, the first band I went to New York with was Mosley, 1943. Earlier that year I went to New York with Snubs and I joined Basie later and then went to Canada, Chicago, New York, Boston.
